restoration_note: This teaching contrasts the cooperative molding/adorning/nourishing of the new grain by the five elements (heat warming, cold nourishing — love and form-holding truth working together in the natural-rational structure) with Hyle's energeia flooding those same elemental channels with her shadow, ruining the fruits of all the trees. Most gaps are well-constrained editor restorations confirmed by traces, parallel formulae across line-breaks (the ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ split, the ⲧⲉⲥϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ doublet), and standard Coptic morphology (ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ genitive, conjunctive ⲛ̄ⲥⲉ-, ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏϩ relative qualitative). The decorative ⲣⲏ marker and the ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ/ⲍⲙⲱϩ heat-pair are confirmed by the immediate antithesis with ⲡⲁⲣⲁϣ 'cold' on the next line. Gap {2}, with only three characters and one trace dot in a context where multiple 3-char growth/molding verbs could fit between ⲙⲁⲁⲛⲕⲟ 'mold' and ⲧⲥⲁⲓⲟ 'adorn,' remained too weakly constrained to fix with confidence.

restorations.basis: Connector ⲛ- linking the relative clause ⲉⲧⲉϣⲁⲩⲙⲁⲁⲛⲕⲟ̈ to the parallel ⲥⲉⲧⲉⲕⲁⲥ ⲁⲛ in line 3; editor's proposal fits the syntactic linkage of the two paired actions (mold / destroy through the elements).
Decorative ⲣⲏ-marker matching the ornamental ⲣⲏ at the line opening and parallels on adjacent lines; not a lexical fill but a paragraphos-style sign.

Three characters with only one ambiguous trace dot, sitting between conjunctive ⲛ̄ⲥⲉ- and what could be either a preposition ⲛ̄- or the start of ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲧⲥⲁⲓⲁⲥ. Several short verbs (ⲣⲱⲧ 'sprout,' ⲁⲉⲓ 'grow,' a third action between mold and adorn) all fit the spiritual sequence equally well; no single fill is constrained.

Completes ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ 'the heat,' confirmed by visible ⲡⲍ at line end and ⲙ at start of next line; ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ ⲍⲙⲱϩ 'the heat warms' is the elemental antithesis to ⲡⲁⲣⲁϣ 'cold' that follows — the love-warmth pole of the cooperative natural-rational work.
Single-letter restoration completing ⲍⲙⲱϩ 'warms/is hot' (Lyc. counterpart of ϩⲙⲟⲙ), paired antithetically with ⲡⲁⲣⲁϣ 'cold' as the love-and-form-holding-truth dyad that nourishes the new grain.

Completes ⲡϣⲏⲛ 'the tree' (lexicon: tree = perception that grows and bears fruit). The 'whole tree' English alongside the agricultural register of new-grain-and-tree (= perception-organism nourished by elements) makes this near-certain.
Completes ϩⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ 'through them' — the same compound preposition ϩⲓⲧⲛ̄/ϩⲓⲧⲟⲟⲧ⸗ used for the elemental channels. English '-ugh those' confirms 'through those (elements).'

Completes ⲥⲕⲁⲛ- of Lyc. ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ (= Greek σκανδαλίζειν, 'stumble/take offense'), continuing across the line break. Spiritually fits: men stumbling when the receiving medium is shadow-flooded by Hyle's energeia.
Continuation of ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲁⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ from previous line; Lyc. ⲁⲁ representing Greek δα. Confirmed by visible ⲗⲓⲍⲉ following.

Completes [ⲉⲧⲟ]ⲩⲛⲏϩ, the relative qualitative of ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'dwell' modifying ⲧϩⲩⲗⲏ — 'Hyle which dwells in them.' Spiritually exact: Hyle as the corrupt receptive principle dwelling within the elemental channels she floods.
Feminine possessive prefix on ϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'shadow,' giving ⲧⲉⲥϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'her shadow' (Hyle's). English 'her' confirmed by parallel ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲥ-|[ϩⲁⲓⲃ]ⲉⲥ in next line.

Same word ⲡⲉⲥϩⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'her shadow' from previous line, split across line break with -ⲉⲥ ending visible at start of this line; spiritual anchor: Hyle's shadow upon the elements destroying the fruits of perception.
Standard genitive ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ linking ⲛ̄ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ 'the fruits' (line 25) to ⲛ̄ϣⲏⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all the trees' — 'fruits of all the trees,' the works of life ruined at the level of perception.
